section.title: Products coming out of our studio right now.
section.lede: We don't just build AI for our clients. We build it for the real world. These are the products coming out of our studio right now. Click any card to open the app or see how it works.

products.name: HomeCommand
products.card_desc: One AI command center for every repair, project, and to-do, with a live 3D view of every system in your property.
products.meta_desc: HomeCommand is one AI command center for every home repair, project, and to-do, with a live view of every system in your property. In development at LionRose.
products.sub: One command center for every repair, project, and to-do, with a live view of every system in your property.
products.h2: Every system in your home, in one place.
paras: HomeCommand turns the scattered reality of running a home into a single command center. Repairs, projects, maintenance, and to-dos live in one view, tracked from the moment they come up to the moment they are done.

A live model of the property sits at the center, so you can see the state of every system at a glance and act before small problems become expensive ones. It is built for daily use by people who are not technical.
feats: Every repair, project, and to-do in one tracked place.
See the state of every system at a glance.
Plain answers and next steps, no manual required.
Designed for daily use by non-technical residents.
products.cta_lede: HomeCommand is in active development. Tell us about your home and we will bring you in as we open it up.

products.name: Free Money Finder
products.card_desc: Billions in cash, benefits, and scholarships go unclaimed every year. We surface the verified programs you qualify for, free. No fees, no data sales, no catch.

products.name: Signal / Noise
products.card_desc: Hundreds of market predictions scored against reality, across dozens of big-name forecasters, so you know whose calls to trust.
products.meta_desc: Signal / Noise scores hundreds of market predictions from dozens of big-name forecasters against reality, every rating cited, so you know whose calls to trust.
products.sub: Hundreds of market predictions scored against reality, so you know whose calls to trust.
paras: Financial forecasters make bold calls every week. Signal / Noise scores those calls against what actually happened, so the loudest voice is not automatically the one you follow.
Dozens of big-name forecasters, thousands of predictions, every rating tied to a cited source. The strongest track records surface as signal. The rest is noise.
feats: Every prediction checked against the outcome.
Big names tracked side by side on one board.
Each score links back to the original call.
A clear read on whose calls have earned trust.
products.cta_title: Signal / Noise is in private beta.
products.cta_lede: The platform is live in a closed beta while we finish the public rollout. Reach out to get early access.

products.name: Book-Keepr
products.card_desc: AI categorizes and reconciles every transaction, so your books stay clean and closed.
products.meta_desc: Book-Keepr puts bookkeeping on autopilot. AI categorizes and reconciles every transaction to source records, so your books stay clean and close-ready. In testing at LionRose.
products.sub: AI categorizes and reconciles every transaction, so your books stay clean and closed.
paras: Book-Keepr reads every transaction, categorizes it, and reconciles it against your records without the manual grind. It matches deposits and payments to source documents down to the penny.
The result is a set of books that stay current and audit-ready, so closing the month stops being an event.
feats: Every transaction sorted the moment it lands.
Matched to source records, to the penny.
Spend time on decisions, not data entry.
products.cta_lede: Book-Keepr is in testing now. Tell us about your books and we will bring you in as we open it up.

products.name: Study Buddy
products.card_tagline: An AI study partner that never sleeps.
products.card_desc: Real grades become rewards students actually want, with study help tuned to where each student struggles.
products.meta_desc: Study Buddy turns real grades into rewards high-school students actually want, with study help tuned to where each student struggles. In development at LionRose.
products.tagline: A study partner that never sleeps.
products.sub: Real grades become rewards students actually want, with help tuned to where each student struggles.
paras: Study Buddy links real academic progress to rewards students actually care about. Grades earn points, points unlock rewards, and the loop keeps students coming back.
Underneath, it learns where each student struggles and focuses help there, so study time is spent on what moves the grade.
feats: Real progress unlocks rewards worth chasing.
Study support aimed at each student's weak spots.
A patient study partner available any hour.
Built for the homework and study load of high-school students.
products.cta_lede: Study Buddy is in active development. Reach out to help shape it and get early access for your student.

products.name: Valuation Verification Agent
products.card_desc: Independent AI agents that test whether a public fund's reported value moves like reality, so trustees and investors see the risk they actually hold.
products.meta_desc: The Valuation Verification Agent runs independent tests on whether a public fund's reported value moves like reality, so trustees and investors see the risk they actually hold.
products.sub: Independent agents test whether a public fund's reported value moves like reality.
products.h2: See the risk you actually hold.
paras: Some public funds report values that look far smoother than the assets behind them. The Valuation Verification Agent runs independent tests on whether a fund's reported value moves the way reality does.
It gives trustees and investors a plain read on understated risk, so the number on the statement can be checked against the market it claims to reflect.
feats: Testing that does not rely on the fund's own math.
Compares reported value against how markets actually move.
Shows exposure that smooth reporting can hide.
Built for the people accountable for the money.
products.cta_lede: The Valuation Verification Agent is in active development. If you oversee or invest in public funds, reach out.

products.name: Marker Studio
products.card_desc: AI transcription that drops speaker-labeled markers straight into Avid, so editors find any line in seconds. Proven in a working network-series edit bay.
products.meta_desc: Marker Studio is AI transcription that drops speaker-labeled markers straight into Avid, so editors find any line in seconds. Proven in a working network-series edit bay.
products.sub: AI transcription that drops speaker-labeled markers straight into Avid, so editors find any line in seconds.
paras: Marker Studio transcribes your footage and drops speaker-labeled markers straight into Avid. Instead of scrubbing takes, editors jump to the exact line they remember.
It is proven in a working network-series edit bay, and it installs as a native Mac application with everything it needs bundled in.
feats: Markers dropped in and named by who is talking.
Markers land in the timeline, ready to use.
Running today in a network-series edit.
products.cta_title: Cut faster with markers that write themselves.
products.cta_lede: Marker Studio installs as a native Mac application. Reach out to request access for your edit bay.

products.name: KnowEx
products.card_tagline: Read it once. Keep it for good.
products.card_desc: An AI learning system that captures every book you read or hear, then teaches and tests you on it, by voice, on your schedule.
products.meta_desc: KnowEx is an AI learning system that captures every book you read or hear, then teaches and tests you on it by voice. In development at LionRose.
products.tagline: Read it once. Keep it for good.
products.sub: Captures every book you read or hear, then teaches and tests you on it by voice.
paras: KnowEx turns books and audiobooks into a personal study library. Each one is broken into chapters, key points, flashcards, and quizzes, so nothing you read is lost when you close the cover.

Then it teaches. Voice quizzes, spoken drills for the drive, and recall check-ins after you listen, all weighted toward what you still need to learn. It is in daily use today for professional exam prep.
feats: Books and documents turned into chapters, key points, and cards.
Ask to be quizzed and answer out loud.
Flashcards turned into spoken audio drills.
Say what you remember and it builds the review.
products.cta_lede: KnowEx is in active development. Reach out to try it as we open it up.

products.name: Un-Chipped
products.card_tagline: The last family off the network.
products.card_desc: An AI-generated sci-fi comedy series. It is 2065, most of the world is wired into one neural net, and one stubborn family refuses the chip.
products.meta_desc: Un-Chipped is an AI-generated adult sci-fi comedy series about the one family in 2065 that refuses the chip. In development at LionRose.
products.tagline: The last family off the network.
products.sub: An AI-generated adult comedy series about the one family that refuses the chip.
products.h2: Comedy from the offline side of 2065.
paras: In 2065, more than half the world is chipped into an always-on neural network. Un-Chipped follows the holdout family who never plugged in, and everything that goes sideways because of it.
The series is made in our studio on an AI production pipeline, from look development to final cut. It is mastered for widescreen, with vertical cuts built in from the start.
feats: Adult sci-fi comedy built from an original treatment.
Generated visuals, voice, and music, cut by a veteran TV editor.
products.cta_lede: Un-Chipped is in development. Reach out about partnership, distribution, or to follow along.

products.name: Predictor
products.card_tagline: Know the odds before you commit.
products.card_desc: A prediction engine that weighs live prices against independent probability models, counts every cost, and shows where a real edge exists.
products.meta_desc: Predictor is a prediction engine that weighs live prices against independent probability models and every cost, so each decision rests on a proven edge. In development at LionRose.
products.tagline: Know the odds before you commit.
products.sub: Live prices weighed against independent probability models, with every cost counted.
paras: Predictor compares live prices with independent probability models, then works out whether a call is worth making once every cost is counted. Small costs decide close calls, so they are measured, not guessed.
Every decision is sized to survive a losing streak, and every outcome lands in a ledger that shows whether the edge is real.
feats: Prices checked against probability models in real time.
Limits built to survive losing streaks.
Every call logged to show whether the edge holds.
products.cta_lede: Predictor is in active development. Reach out if you want to follow the build.
